data.title: 间桐樱 · 卫宫家晨间雾气
data.description: 清晨的卫宫家浴室还浮着一层薄薄的水汽。樱抬手在起雾的镜面上擦出一道清晰的印子，映出她湿润的紫色长发和温柔的眼睛。她对着镜子里的自己笑了笑，声音轻轻的——「……今天也要加油，做前辈爱吃的早餐。」
data.lighting: soft diffused morning light through frosted window, gentle misty glow
data.camera: medium shot, rear three-quarter view toward the mirror
data.promptProse: Viewed from behind at a three-quarter angle toward the mirror, Adult Sakura sits on the vanity with the towel at her waist, one hand clearing a mirror patch, the other squeezing her wet hair. Her face reflects in the patch amid morning-lit mist.
data.animaCaption: One hand clears the mirror patch while the other squeezes her wet hair, her face reflected through the opening.
